body:
## Summary
- harden the Phase 0 aggregate file-transfer product E2E source revalidation by requiring each direction to carry a valid 32-character hex session_id_hex
- require Android->macOS and macOS->Android file-transfer evidence to share the same session_id_hex before the aggregate can accept the source.product_e2e record
- add a regression test showing mismatched same-session evidence remains insufficient

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release.Phase0StableReleaseTest.test_file_transfer_product_e2e_source_requires_same_session_id -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse origin/main) make phase0-stable-release-gate returns expected exit 2
- git diff --check

## Boundaries
- Evidence-tool hardening only; no README/manifest/evidence refresh and no Android UI/UX changes.
- No Host GUI, TCC, adb reverse, or external hardware path was used.
- This does not close file-transfer product E2E or any Phase 0 physical/runtime gate; the aggregate remains blocked with 7 required gates open/blocked/insufficient.
title: test(evidence): require file-transfer session match
